name: OpenSlides
description: OpenSlides is a free, open-source, offline desktop app that turns source code into polished, presentation-ready slides with smooth, step-by-step Magic Move transitions. It is a direct alternative to codeslides.app: create expressive code decks, keep your work on your own machine, and present without a subscription or internet connection.
highlights: Magic Move transitions between code states
Line-by-line stepped highlights with per-step emphasis control
Full screen, autoplay, keyboard navigation, and drag-and-drop slide stacks
Local-first with installers for macOS, Windows, and Linux
curatorNote: A free, offline alternative to CodeSlides for animated code talks — 176 stars in under three weeks.
